title: Efficient Learning Survey
description: A demonstration of a reusable research collection: methods, evidence and evaluation in one place.

categories.label: Foundations
categories.description: Concepts that organize the field and its assumptions.

categories.label: Model compression
categories.description: Methods for reducing computation and storage.

sections.heading: A question-driven collection
sections.text: How should we compare learning methods when compute, memory and data are limited? This demonstration groups a collection by research question and keeps every record connected to its source.

sections.heading: Evidence and tradeoffs
sections.text: The records below are fictional examples used to demonstrate the template. A real survey should specify measurement conditions and report the tradeoff between quality and resource use.
